answer: Each agent must post a bond from a scarce, non-reusable resource before it can earn rewards; the protocol slashes that bond when an agent’s claimed work fails independent checks or conflicts with its other identities. A creator can still mint a thousand mirror accounts, but each needs real capital locked at risk, and coordinated fraud risks losing it. The cost scales with fake identities, whether the resource is an ocean of compute credits or a relic token with limited supply.
